idea-plugin.name: Java Portable
idea-plugin.description:
Open and run Java files without installing another IDE. PhpStorm, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, RubyMine, CLion and Rider ship no Java support at all — a single .java file today means downloading IntelliJ IDEA just to read it. Java Portable fills that gap in the IDE you already have.

  • Portable JDK — download an Eclipse Temurin LTS build from inside the IDE (like the JDK downloader in IDEA). Stored under ~/.java-portable, self-contained, and it touches nothing else on your machine — no JAVA_HOME to set, no system install, no conflict with an existing JDK.
  • Run with one click — a green ▶ gutter marker next to main, plus right-click ▸ Run. Uses single-file source launch (java Hello.java), so there is no compile step, no output folder and no project setup — the file just runs.
  • Code intelligence (optional) — completion, go-to-definition, hover docs and diagnostics via Eclipse JDT LS, the same server VS Code's Java extension uses, bridged with the free LSP4IJ plugin. It runs on the JDK you already downloaded. Fully offline.
  • Syntax highlighting — for .java files (keywords, strings and text blocks, numbers, annotations, Javadoc), even without the language server.
  • Run JDK tools — javac, jshell, javap and jar in a console.

Ideal for the one-off: a snippet you're learning from, an interview exercise, a class file from a colleague, or the one Java service in an otherwise PHP/Python/Go codebase.

In IntelliJ IDEA and Android Studio the real Java support is far better than anything this plugin offers, so it deliberately does not load there at all.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0
  • Initial release.
  • Download a self-contained Temurin LTS JDK from inside the IDE (macOS, Linux and Windows), isolated under ~/.java-portable.
  • Run a .java file with single-file source launch — ▶ gutter marker next to main, no compile step.
  • Optional Eclipse JDT LS code intelligence via LSP4IJ (one-click setup), lexer-based syntax highlighting, and a javac / jshell / javap / jar runner.
